summary: As part of release 13.1, we have added a bit of functionality to Go’s custom command. Accordingly, the task menu item has changed from ‘Custom Command’ to ‘More’.

title: [Webinar] End-to-End Automated Build and Deployment Pipeline with Maven
summary: Maven based build pipelines are fairly common. Chef based deployment pipelines are also gaining traction. In this talk, Sriram will demonstrate how to design and connect the two using Go. Along the way he'll explain why not to use maven-snaphosts, how to make Chef talk to Nexus and provide several tips on Go usage.
